notes.title: 🎉 New Demo 2.0 Update is Live! 🎮
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone! We’ve been listening closely to your feedback and are excited to drop a brand-new version of the demo with some big improvements, new content, and game adjustements![/b]

[h2]✨ New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] 💡 [b]Bonus Levels Section:[/b] A brand new space for regular community level drops(stay tuned)!
[*] 📦 To celebrate Sokoban Fest, we've added [b]more the box pushing levels[/b] into Chapter 1!
[*] 💬 [b]Discord Connection:[/b] Link your account and earn in-game rewards through Discord!
[*] 💾 [b]Save Slots:[/b] You can now have multiple playthroughs without losing progress.
[/list]

[h2]🛠️ Game Adjustments[/h2]
[b]Many of you mentioned the game was a bit too tough. So we’ve balanced things out.[/b]
[list]
[*][b] Easier levels added[/b] to smooth out the early experience.
[*] [b]Tougher challenges moved to a new Bonus Content section[/b] for those craving a real challenge!
[/list]

[h2]🚀 Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🖥️ [b]Optimized Performance[/b] for smoother gameplay
[*] 🎨 [b]Enhanced Graphics[/b] to make the world look even better
[*] 🛠️ [b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[/list]

[h2]🔜 [b]Coming Soon[/b][/h2]
🎮 [b]Controller Support[/b] for an even better play experience
🌍 [b]localization[/b] into additional languages so more players can join the fun!


[u][b]Try out the update and let us know what you think on discord:[/b][/u]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/VxVEbpHhXs]Discord Server Welcome Back Games[/url]

[h2]Thanks everyone for your support!❤️[/h2]

WARNING:
This is a new demo with new features. Since we've also introduced a new save slot system, the old save file is not compatible with this version of the sacrifice.

notes.title: A Puzzle Game With Mirrored Controls?!
notes.content:
We'd like to start a series about all the features of [i]The Sacrifice[/i] to familiarize you with the gameplay. Let's begin with a unique, yet fundamental mechanic:

[h2]THE MIRROR MOVEMENT[/h2]

In [i]The Sacrifice[/i], you take on the role of Sarah in the eerie, atmospheric setting of 17th century Salem. Your task is to guide William to the bonfire while keeping everyone alive. The twist? Every move you make as Sarah, William will make the opposite movement. Imagine it like moving in a mirror!

[h3]How does it work?[/h3]

[list]
    [*][b]Vertical and Horizontal Movement:[/b] Sarah can move up, down, left, and right on the tiles. Every step Sarah takes, William takes the exact opposite step. If Sarah moves up, William moves down. If Sarah moves left, William moves right.
    [*][b]Strategic Navigation:[/b] Your goal is to navigate William to a specific tile that will ignite a bonfire, signaling the completion of the level. Careful planning is crucial as every step you take impacts both Sarah's and William's position.
    [*][b]Puzzle Solving:[/b] Each level presents new challenges and dangers. You'll need to think ahead, considering how Sarah's movements will affect William's path. One wrong move could lead to peril, so stay sharp!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44945111/8cffab4308a175dc0b998f72eeda0af9b57f0d18.gif[/img]

[h3]Tips for Success:[/h3]

[list]
    [*][u]Plan Ahead:[/u] Always think a few steps ahead. Visualize how each move Sarah makes will impact William's movements.
    [*][u]Observe the Environment:[/u] Pay attention to the layout of each level. Look out for obstacles and hazards that could hinder your William's path.
    [*][u]Trial and Error:[/u] Don’t be afraid to experiment. Sometimes, the best way to solve a puzzle is through trial and error.
[/list]

Dive into the mystical and challenging world of [i]The Sacrifice[/i] and use the mirror movement. Stay tuned for more gameplay insights and tips!

Happy adventuring, and may the bonfires guide your way!
